masterDefinition: sum of loop stems (for loop) or sum of stem_double stems (for double); no make_loop; no tanh; no normalization

contextMix.description: Full 4-stem mix (2N). Target stem x DOUBLE_CONTEXT_BOOST, each other stem x DOUBLE_CONTEXT_OTHERS, then renormalized to TARGET_RMS_DB per target. This is the racing_*_double.wav file, intended for Suno / audio-model ingestion so the model hears the full picture with the target stem dominant. The solo reference is racing_*_stem_double.wav.

pipeline: 7. build 4 context doubles (2N): target x BOOST, others x OTHERS, renorm
8. master_double = sum(2N stem doubles); master_loop = sum(N loops); verify identity
9. write 4 stems x (_loop, _stem_double, _double) + master x (_loop, _double) + manifest

FIX-1.name: kick click artifact in motion stem
FIX-1.fix: squared fade-out of 30 ms on kick envelope (KICK_FADE_OUT_SEC)
FIX-1.symptom: sharp click after every kick in racing_motion_loop.wav solo
FIX-1.doNotRemove: verify motion stem loop and stem_double clean before changing KICK_FADE_OUT_SEC

FIX-2.name: stereo reverb mono collapse
FIX-2.fix: per-channel convolution for stereo inputs (no mono collapse)
FIX-2.symptom: high frequencies missing in master, present in wind_exp solo

earTunedValues.note: tuned by ear against racing_master_loop.wav and stem solos; do not change without re-listening

playerNotes.loopFile: Use racing_*_loop.wav for AudioBufferSourceNode.loop=true in the game.
playerNotes.stemDoubleFile: Solo stem double (2N). Use for A/B comparison against the original solo loop and for regression testing of FIX-1/FIX-2. Not for Suno.
playerNotes.contextDoubleFile: Full 4-stem context mix with target stem boosted. Use racing_*_double.wav for Suno / audio-model ingestion.
playerNotes.masterIsReferenceOnly: In-game, mix the 4 loop stems; master is a preview of the full unity mix.
playerNotes.stereoReverbFix: wind_exp is stereo; its reverb is applied per-channel (no mono collapse). Other 9 buses are mono and use legacy path.
playerNotes.preset: To experiment, add a new preset to PRESETS; do not edit production in place.
playerNotes.v8ToV9Migration: In v8, racing_*_double.wav was the SOLO double. In v9 it is the CONTEXT mix. The solo double in v9 is racing_*_stem_double.wav. If you have v8 _double files in your output folder, delete them before running v9 to avoid confusion.
